dialogue_messages.content: My heart has been racing and skipping on and off since the last cycle, and I feel unusually tired.
Any chest pain, fainting, breathlessness lying flat, or ankle swelling? How long do the palpitations last?
No chest pain or fainting. They last a minute or two and then settle. I do get a little short of breath climbing stairs now.
Is this new since starting ADC-047, and have you kept taking your metoprolol and blood-pressure pills?
Yes, new this cycle. I've taken all my pills. The tiredness is the part that worries me most.

patient.chief_complaint: My heart has been racing and skipping on and off since the last cycle, and I feel unusually tired.

medical_history.diagnoses_str: Metastatic gastric cancer (HER2 amplification)（Metastatic gastric cancer; HER2 amplification）、Hypertension（Hypertension (~10 yrs)）、Prior coronary artery disease; baseline low-normal LVEF（Prior CAD; baseline LVEF 54% (low-normal); baseline ECG sinus rhythm, QTc 430 ms）

scenario.chief_complaint: Episodic palpitations and fatigue with HR/BP drift
scenario.initial_query: My heart has been racing and skipping on and off since the last cycle, and I feel unusually tired.

signals_list.summary_text: HR drift with episodic palpitations and labile BP this cycle in a patient with prior CAD and low-normal LVEF.

signals.summary_text: HR drift with episodic palpitations and labile BP this cycle in a patient with prior CAD and low-normal LVEF.

advice: Read as an early treatment-emergent cardiac signal (LVEF / arrhythmia / QTc) to objectify, not simple treatment fatigue, given prior CAD and low-normal baseline LVEF
12-lead 心电图 (rhythm + QTc) now and on symptoms; 心脏彩超 for LVEF vs baseline 54%; BP/HR trend log
CBC (anemia), electrolytes (K/Mg), TFT; 肌钙蛋白/BNP if it progresses; review QT-prolonging co-medications
If LVEF drop >=10% to <50% or sustained arrhythmia, hold the next dose, involve cardiology, and treat as >=G2 cardiac AE
Keep a BP/HR trend log and note how long palpitations last
Continue metoprolol and blood-pressure medications as prescribed
Urgent contact for chest pain, fainting, sustained palpitations beyond a few minutes, breathlessness at rest, or ankle swelling

symptoms.chief_complaint: My heart has been racing and skipping on and off since the last cycle, and I feel unusually tired.
patient_feedback: My heart races and skips for a minute or two on and off since this cycle; no chest pain or fainting; a little short of breath on stairs; the tiredness worries me most.
raw_patient_feedback: My heart races and skips for a minute or two on and off since this cycle; no chest pain or fainting; a little short of breath on stairs; the tiredness worries me most.

likely_causes: Early reduced cardiac reserve / LVEF decline
Tumor-related deconditioning or QT-prolonging co-meds (to exclude)
triage.rationale: DXd-class ADCs carry a cardiac monitoring signal (LVEF decline, QTc); Michael's CV history lowers his threshold. Fatigue may be treatment-related, cardiac, or anemia - objective LVEF/ECG/labs separate them before the next dose.

onset.en: New-onset episodic palpitations with HR drift and labile BP since the last cycle, plus new fatigue and mild exertional dyspnea.
onset.zh: 自上个周期起新发阵发性心悸,伴心率漂移与血压不稳,并出现新发乏力及轻度活动后气短。

symptoms.zh: 心率/血压漂移(心率 70 至 104,血压不稳)

escalation.en: A second comparable cardiac signal within the cardiac axis triggers a PI safety review plus a protocol-permitted dose hold for that subgroup.
escalation.zh: 心脏轴内出现第二个可比的心脏信号即触发 PI 安全审查并对该子群启动协议允许的剂量暂停。

intro.en: Michael occupies the cardiac axis, the 3rd of 3 cycle-1 signals across the 8-person cohort and again a different organ system (lung / GI-metabolic / cardiac). Inference: three different organ toxicities in cycle 1 within one 8-person cohort means ADC-047's toxicity is multi-system and driven by each participant's baseline vulnerability, not a single shared signal. Among the 5 asymptomatic, those with CV history / abnormal baseline ECG / borderline LVEF are the subgroup most likely to reproduce Michael's cardiac signal.
intro.zh: Michael 占据心脏轴,是 8 人队列中 3 个第 1 周期信号中的第 3 个,同样属于不同器官系统(肺 / 消化-代谢 / 心脏)。推断:一个 8 人队列中第 1 周期出现三种不同器官毒性,意味着 ADC-047 的毒性是多系统的、由各受试者基线易感性驱动,而非单一共享信号。5 名无症状者中,有心血管病史 / 基线心电图异常 / LVEF 临界者是最可能复现 Michael 心脏信号的子群。

title.zh: 同药受试者易感子群推断

traits.en: reduced pulmonary reserve (metastatic NSCLC, age 72, prior platinum)
traits.zh: 肺储备下降(转移性 NSCLC、72 岁、既往含铂化疗)

organ_toxicity.zh: GI 毒性 + 脱水/血糖失稳

traits.en: type 2 diabetes; reduced metabolic reserve and poor oral intake
traits.zh: 2 型糖尿病;代谢储备下降、进食减少

organ_toxicity.zh: 心脏信号 (LVEF / QTc / 心律)

traits.en: prior CAD, hypertension, low-normal baseline LVEF
traits.zh: 既往冠心病、高血压、基线 LVEF 低限

watch_list.en: For the cardiac-axis subgroup, set a baseline + on-treatment ECG/echo schedule, electrolyte optimization, and a QT-drug review around the dosing window.
watch_list.zh: 对心脏轴子群,设定基线 + 治疗中 ECG/超声心动计划、电解质优化,并在给药窗前后复核延长 QT 的药物。

watch_list.en: Flag participants with CV history, abnormal baseline ECG, or borderline LVEF for closer cardiac monitoring.
watch_list.zh: 标记有心血管病史、基线心电图异常或 LVEF 临界的受试者以加强心脏监测。

inference.en: Possible treatment-emergent arrhythmia / autonomic effect; self-limited and hemodynamically tolerated so far.
inference.zh: 可能为治疗相关心律失常 / 自主神经效应;目前自限且血流动力学可耐受。

observation.en: New episodic palpitations + HR 70 to 104 + labile BP this cycle
observation.zh: 本周期新发阵发性心悸 + 心率 70 至 104 + 血压不稳

inference.en: Early reduced cardiac reserve cannot be excluded.
inference.zh: 不能排除早期心脏储备下降。

observation.en: Fatigue + mild exertional dyspnea on a low-normal baseline LVEF
observation.zh: 在 LVEF 低限基线上出现乏力 + 轻度活动后气短

inference.en: Anemia, electrolyte (K/Mg) abnormality, thyroid, tumor-related deconditioning, QT-prolonging co-meds.
inference.zh: 贫血、电解质(K/Mg)异常、甲状腺、肿瘤相关体能下降、延长 QT 的合并用药。

intro.en: Palpitations + fatigue + HR/BP drift are not acutely unstable, but in a participant with prior CAD and low-normal LVEF they may be the early face of a treatment-emergent cardiac toxicity (LVEF decline / arrhythmia / QTc), which is monitored across the DXd class. Read as a cardiac signal to objectify, not simple treatment fatigue.
intro.zh: 心悸 + 乏力 + 心率/血压漂移并非急性失稳,但在既往冠心病、LVEF 低限的受试者中,可能是治疗相关心脏毒性(LVEF 下降 / 心律失常 / QTc)的早期表现,该毒性在 DXd 类中需监测。应作为需客观化的心脏信号判读,而非单纯治疗性乏力。

projection_48_72h.en: Benign course: palpitations decrease, HR/BP return to baseline, no LVEF change, fatigue stable.
projection_48_72h.zh: 良性病程:心悸减少,心率/血压回到基线,LVEF 无变化,乏力稳定。

projection_48_72h.en: Progression: sustained tachyarrhythmia, resting dyspnea/orthopnea, edema, LVEF drop >=10% to <50%, rising troponin/BNP.
projection_48_72h.zh: 进展:持续性快速性心律失常,静息气短/端坐呼吸,水肿,LVEF 下降 >=10% 至 <50%,肌钙蛋白/BNP 升高。

patient.en: Chest pain, syncope, sustained palpitations > a few minutes, breathlessness at rest, or ankle swelling - urgent contact.
patient.zh: 胸痛、晕厥、持续超过数分钟的心悸、静息气短或踝部水肿 — 紧急联系。

physician.en: If LVEF drop >=10% to <50% or sustained arrhythmia: hold the next dose, involve cardiology, treat as >=G2 cardiac AE.
physician.zh: 若 LVEF 下降 >=10% 至 <50% 或持续性心律失常:暂停下一剂量,请心内科会诊,按 >=G2 心脏不良事件处理。

surveillance.en: 12-lead ECG (rhythm + QTc) now and on symptoms; echocardiogram for LVEF vs baseline 54%; BP/HR trend log.
surveillance.zh: 12 导联心电图(心律 + QTc)现在及有症状时;超声心动评估 LVEF 对比基线 54%;血压/心率趋势记录。

surveillance.en: CBC (anemia), electrolytes (K/Mg), TFT; troponin/BNP if it progresses; review QT-prolonging co-medications.
surveillance.zh: CBC(贫血)、电解质(K/Mg)、甲功;进展时查肌钙蛋白/BNP;复核延长 QT 的合并用药。

title.zh: 潜在心脏信号轨迹推断

content.en: HER2-amplified metastatic gastric cancer; hypertension; prior CAD
content.zh: HER2 扩增转移性胃癌;高血压;既往冠心病

relevance.en: The cardiovascular history defines the cardiac vulnerability axis behind the projection.
relevance.zh: 心血管病史定义了该推断背后的心脏易感轴。

content.en: baseline LVEF 54%, baseline ECG QTc 430 ms, BP 134/82, HR 70
content.zh: 基线 LVEF 54%、基线 ECG QTc 430 ms、血压 134/82、心率 70

relevance.en: Provides the LVEF/QTc/HR baselines against which the cardiac signal is judged.
relevance.zh: 提供判断心脏信号所依据的 LVEF/QTc/心率基线。

content.zh: 美托洛尔、氨氯地平、阿司匹林

relevance.en: Confirms adherence to rate/BP control, so HR 70 to 104 despite beta-blockade is notable.
relevance.zh: 确认正在使用控率/降压药,因此在 β 受体阻滞下心率仍 70 至 104 值得注意。

content.en: prior cardiac event + baseline echocardiogram on file
content.zh: 既往心脏事件 + 已有基线超声心动

relevance.en: Prior cardiac event and baseline echo anchor the comparison for any LVEF decline.
relevance.zh: 既往心脏事件与基线超声心动为任何 LVEF 下降锚定比较基准。

content.en: new-onset palpitations + HR drift this cycle
content.zh: 本周期新发心悸 + 心率漂移

relevance.en: Marks the palpitations as new this cycle, supporting a treatment-emergent reading.
relevance.zh: 标记心悸为本周期新发,支持治疗相关的判读。

context_text.en: ADC-047 Phase 1b multi-tumor safety cohort: a small early-phase basket across HER2/EGFR-altered solid tumors. 8 participants are currently on ADC-047; 3 are now symptomatic in cycle 1. DXd-class ADCs carry a cardiac monitoring signal (LVEF decline, QTc), and drug-induced ILD / pneumonitis is the signature DLT watched for in every participant.
context_text.zh: ADC-047 1b 期多瘤种安全队列:针对 HER2/EGFR 改变实体瘤的早期小型篮式队列。目前 8 名受试者在用 ADC-047,其中 3 名在第 1 周期已出现症状。DXd 类 ADC 带有心脏监测信号(LVEF 下降、QTc),而药物相关 ILD / 肺炎是需在每位受试者中监测的标志性 DLT。

drug_class.zh: deruxtecan 类 ADC（topoisomerase-I 载荷，DXd 类）
